summary: Daughter of Raffaele Colosimo and Filippina Iera of San Mango d'Aquino, wife of Domenico Fiorillo; John's maternal 3rd-great-grandmother.
bio:
Saveria Colosimo was baptized at San Mango d'Aquino in Calabria on 26 October 1848, and was probably born the day before, the daughter of Raffaele Colosimo and Filippina Iera. Colosimo is one of the oldest and commonest surnames of San Mango, counted among the town's traditional families. On 1 April 1870 she married Domenico Gabriele Fiorillo in the San Mango parish.

Family records give her death as 26 May 1926 at San Mango, but the parish burial register has a Saveria Colosimo, widow of Domenico Fiorillo, buried on 10 August 1931 with an age that does not quite fit; the records disagree on when she died. She is John's maternal 3rd-great-grandmother.

researchNotes:
Tree: Saveria Colosimo (1848-1926). Colosimo is one of the commonest San Mango surnames: 652 entries in the 1674-1804 parish stati delle anime; Colosimo x14 in the mid-1990s San Mango phone directory; listed by ItalianSide among the town's traditional families. A Gaetano Colosimo, 40, witnessed Domenico Fiorillo's 1840 birth act (relationship unknown).

Saveria was baptized on 26 October 1848, daughter of Raffaele Colosimo and Filippina Iera ([R4-S1]). The tree's 25 October is probably her birth date. She married Domenico Gabriele Fiorillo at San Mango on 1 April 1870 ([R4-S2]). The parish burial index has Saveria Colosimo, widow of Domenico Fiorillo, buried 10 August 1931 with a stated age of 70 ([R4-S3]). Husband and widowhood match (Domenico died 1921), but the age is about twelve years too low. This entry is a candidate for her death and conflicts with the tree's 26 May 1926.
